spec.eligibility: Attractive Growth stage + Higher highs + higher lows structure
spec.philosophy: Preserve structurally healthy growth names; RS, momentum, volume and room-to-resistance rank candidates instead of acting as hard exclusion gates.
spec.freezeRule: Do not tune thresholds from forward outcomes. Any eligibility/ranking change requires a new version/cohort.

attractiveGrowthDiscoveryV1.note: Buckets validate prioritization only; they are not return forecasts or exclusion thresholds.

spec.eligibility: Stage classification only; no RS, momentum, volume, or room-to-resistance hard gate.

rankingOnly.structure: HH/HL strongest; Structure improving supportive; Lower highs + lower lows penalty
rankingOnly.relativeStrength: RS20 >=4 strongest, >=0 supportive, negative values reduce priority but do not exclude
rankingOnly.momentum: positive/improving momentum raises priority; sharp deterioration lowers priority but does not exclude
rankingOnly.volume: up/down volume >=1.2 raises priority; weak volume lowers priority but does not exclude
rankingOnly.roomToResistance: >=7 strongest, >=3 usable; <3 lowers priority but does not exclude

spec.researchFinding: Across four independent batches, single hard gates were unstable. HH/HL + volume showed promise in some batches but failed in others; HH/HL + RS was also inconsistent. Preserve breadth and use the evidence as ranking until forward data is accumulated.
spec.freezeRule: Do not promote a historical winner into an exclusion rule. Any threshold/gate change requires a new version and forward cohort.

hhhlGateAudit.note: Accepted/rejected is a retrospective audit of the HH/HL gate, not a recommendation to hard-filter future candidates.

attractiveGrowthCohortAuditV1.note: Audit whether the stage cohort itself is useful before tuning ranking. No Live/core behavior is changed.

spec.purpose: Test whether setup location explains why the strongest raw momentum/RS bucket can underperform the middle bucket.
spec.rule: Diagnostic only. No dimension is an eligibility gate.
